title: UX: Multiple notifications after a Scene ends
body: ## Describe the issue When a Scene ends (for example **Bike work**), the user has to dismiss several notifications related to the same event. The feature works correctly, but the user interaction feels unnecessarily repetitive. ## Time 2026-07-09, approximately **07:04**. ## Build version - AAPS: **4.0.0-dev-a (c67e)** - Device: **Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra** - Android: **16** ## Steps to reproduce 1. Start a Scene (for example **Bike work**). 2. End the Scene. 3. Observe the Android notifications and the in-app notifications. ## Current behavior After the Scene ends, I have to clear notifications in multiple places: - Android notification: **Scene "Bike work" ended** - Android notification: **Basal profile in pump updated** - In-app notifications with **Dismiss** buttons - The Scene card still shows **Scene ended** until **Close** is pressed. Although these notifications are related to the same action, each one has to be dismissed separately. ## Expected behavior The user should not have to acknowledge the same Scene completion in multiple places. Ideally, a single action should be enough to clear all notifications related to the same event. ## Additional information This is not a functional bug. It is a usability / UX improvement request. Attached files: [Log Export.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29834431/Log.Export.txt) [AndroidAPS_LOG_1783574547059.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29837057/AndroidAPS_LOG_1783574547059.log.zip)
